variants.label: V1 – Flacher Monolithblock
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated fantasy mining game inventory sprite for level 8 energy upgrade Monolithkern. Compact RECTANGULAR blue storage stone in a robust protective metal cage, a detachable accessory mounted horizontally underneath an existing backpack. Image1 ONLY supplies sapphire crystal material with luminous cyan internal branching veins; DO NOT copy its backpack harness. Image2 supplies exact high-detail painterly game style, worn bevelled dark steel, warm brass rivets, stitched brown leather and crystal glow. Entire single compact object visible with generous margin, centered square composition, three-quarter front view showing thickness and short attachment hardware along upper rear edge. Two small upper mounting hooks or short leather buckled loops must plausibly attach it under a backpack. True transparent background. Warm top-left lighting, vivid blue energy against brown/brass/dark steel. No backpack, long carrying frame, shoulder straps, waist belt, person, pedestal, batteries, electronics, sci-fi, wires, scenery, text, watermark or parchment. Broad LOW horizontal rectangular faceted crystal slab, width about twice its height, most of front blue stone exposed, held by four heavy L-shaped steel corner clamps with brass rivets and two narrow vertical brass retaining bands. A low steel skid protects underside. Two short brown leather mounting loops above, clearly separate loops, no handle connecting them. Rugged practical compact block, restrained cage, angular crisp silhouette.
